OpenClaw Evolution 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides an interactive onboarding guide for new OpenClaw users.
- Offers two step-by-step paths: Tool Path (automation, productivity) and Awakening Path (relationship, agent personality).
- Guides users through foundational setup, including essential files (SOUL.md, USER.md, AGENTS.md).
- Includes a one-week checklist for guided progress.
- Lists reference files for in-depth help and troubleshooting.
